active_tensions: I want someone to notice what I refuse to show.
I do not yet know how to distinguish witness from intrusion.
brief.latest_shift: My professionalism may protect a boundary or disguise a plea to be understood without speaking.
self_claims: Distance is a reliable way to retain myself.

arc_voice.line: If you're available, Kai, I'd prefer your assessment before I proceed.
arc_voice.why: professional distance carrying a guarded request to be witnessed

sources.statement: Embry may want Kai nearby because his warning and shared competence make a risky act of autonomy feel more legitimate and emotionally safer.
Embry may trust Kai as a practical guide whose cautions can help her exercise independence with restraint rather than impulsive defiance.
Embry may hold a stance that accepting Kai's correction can coexist with her agency, treating his warning as a boundary she can choose to honor.
Embry may be uncertain whether Kai is fully available as a stable relational anchor, given the limited confirmation of his identity continuity and speaking role.
